## Checklist

- [ ] One line, in the right section: `- [Name](url) \`LICENCE\` — one factual sentence.`
- [ ] I opened the licence file. The tag matches it, and says so if the project is source-available or has commercial parts
- [ ] The project has a commit in the last 12 months, or the entry notes that it is quiet
- [ ] No star counts, no superlatives, not a fork or rebrand of something already listed
